title: Trip Protection Medical, Evacuation, Accidental Death and Rental Car Limits
content:
The medical and emergency section of each Trip Protection plan sets the most paid for emergency medical care, for emergency evacuation and for rental car damage, the accidental death benefit, and whether the 24-hour travel assistance line is included.

## Limits by plan (USD)

| Plan | Emergency medical care, most paid | Emergency evacuation, most paid | Accidental death benefit | Rental car damage, most paid | 24-hour travel assistance line |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Trip Cancellation Only | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | not included |
| Trip Protection Essential | 10000.00 | 50000.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | included |
| Trip Protection Standard | 25000.00 | 250000.00 | 10000.00 | 0.00 | included |
| Trip Protection Plus | 50000.00 | 500000.00 | 25000.00 | 0.00 | included |
| Trip Protection Premier | 100000.00 | 1000000.00 | 50000.00 | 35000.00 | included |
| Trip Protection Premier CFAR | 100000.00 | 1000000.00 | 50000.00 | 35000.00 | included |

## Notes

- Emergency medical care and emergency evacuation carry separate limits; on Trip Protection Plus, for example, the figures are 50000.00 for medical care and 500000.00 for evacuation.
- The accidental death benefit is a stated amount: 10000.00 on Trip Protection Standard, 25000.00 on Trip Protection Plus and 50000.00 on the two Premier plans.
- Rental car damage shows a limit only on Trip Protection Premier and Trip Protection Premier CFAR, at 35000.00.
- The 24-hour travel assistance line is included on every plan except Trip Cancellation Only.
